P.limitations: Primary for exact code/name. Contains ambiguous 6666 and 12345; does not prove behavior on a device.

B.limitations: Cross-check only; derivative, not independent gameplay evidence.

A.limitations: Contains leading-zero and trailer ambiguities; never overrides publisher.

G.limitations: Search-index tables accessible; direct open returned 403. Several labels contradict publisher.

I.limitations: Not developer-owned. Claims are not on-device verification.

R.limitations: Separates RGS from dialer. Prop slot names, not precise object identities.

S.limitations: Has errors such as Supra 2224; cross-check against publisher.

C.limitations: Supports some community codes; not publisher confirmation.

V.limitations: Description reviewed only; video not played or verified frame by frame.

W.limitations: Mixes in codes from a different game and contradicts publisher.

X.limitations: Different game/package. Primary evidence of cross-game contamination.

D.limitations: Alternate dragon/elephant codes; not confirmed by target publisher.

T.limitations: Same alternate claims; duplication across websites is not independent testing.

U.limitations: Labels word commands previously reported; no primary evidence.

H.limitations: Contains duplicate rows and conflicting Bag/Bolero claims.

O.limitations: Historical conflicting labels and stripped zeros; not current verification.

J.limitations: Prints 15 and 0; latest publisher lists 0015 and 0000.

N.limitations: Many misspellings, stripped digits and conflicting pairings; reject unsupported new entries.

M.limitations: 8333 called BMW M3, conflicting with video M4 subtype.

K.limitations: Candidate 100 Police Car; multiple other errors make it insufficient for confirmation.
